text:
John B. Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 2010, as the [Royal Society profile](https://royalsociety.org/people/11514/) and a [UT Austin announcement from May 2010](https://www.me.utexas.edu/news/826-professor-john) both say. The team note's answers of 2019 and 1992 are wrong; 2019 was the year of his Nobel Prize in Chemistry, not his Royal Society election.
CONFIDENCE: 93
